title: MEMO Studio Service Capability Library
source: MEMO Studio GPT research plus verified Lovable project records

services.title: Revit and Dynamo automation
services.problem: BIM teams repeatedly rename, place, tag, schedule, inspect, and export the same information.
services.deliverable: customized Dynamo/Python/Revit automation routines; documented inputs/outputs; error handling; sample project acceptance tests; source/handoff notes.
services.evidence: EnTech/JFK Terminal One coordination; Stantec tooling; HGA CAD/Revit data workflows; repeated professional Dynamo/Grasshopper development.

services.title: BIM QA/QC and coordination dashboards
services.problem: inconsistent naming, mismatched model properties, missing requirements, costly manual checks.
services.deliverable: repeatable model checking procedures, issue reports, dashboards and QA checklists, with clear rules for false positives and human review.
services.evidence: professional coordination on 12 multidisciplinary JFK Revit models and Dynamo QA/QC. Reported outcomes in CVs require validation before publishing a numerical improvement.

services.title: IFC and openBIM model inspection
services.problem: models are trapped in authoring tools or hard to inspect across firms.
services.deliverable: IFC import/inspection workflow, model browser, property/quantity explorer, and structured exports.
services.evidence: IFC generation/export work, browser BIM explorations, IFC Tower Fragment Modeler prototype, American Superblock IFC outputs, That Open/Fragments experimentation.

services.title: IDS-based BIM validation tools
services.problem: project teams need repeatable checks against machine-readable information requirements.
services.deliverable: IFC/IDS rule dashboard, multi-IDS loading, per-rule pass/fail and conformance summaries, exportable issues.
services.evidence: September 2026 IFC Validation Webapp demo described as using OpenBIM Components/Fragments, parallel rule execution and multiple IDS files. No formal certification should be implied.

services.title: Model-version comparison and progress intelligence
services.problem: clients struggle to tell what changed between design submissions.
services.deliverable: compare two model snapshots, inspect element/category changes, provide a change register and progress dashboard.
services.evidence: BIMSpect design-progress intelligence prototype, developed around IFC/viewer workflows in 2026.

services.title: Automated drawing, sheet and BIM reporting tools
services.problem: repetitive schedules, annotations, sheets, exports and model reports.
services.deliverable: scheduled drawing/report generation, door/window/room schedules, QA exports and documented naming conventions.
services.evidence: professional Dynamo and shop-drawing scripting; American Superblock's experimental drawing, schedule and specification workspaces. Outputs must be checked against office and project standards.

services.title: BIM data extraction and integration
services.problem: model data is available but not actionable outside Revit/IFC.
services.deliverable: CSV/JSON/IFC-based data pipelines, filters, dashboards, external database integration, and traceable element IDs.
services.evidence: HGA campus work, IFC experiments, React/TypeScript development; PRISM-era BIM decision-support research.

services.title: Project-specific coordination workflows
services.problem: distributed disciplines cannot consistently exchange or review models.
services.deliverable: a coordination rulebook, issue workflow, automated model intake/checks, reporting templates and operator training.
services.evidence: VDC/BIM roles at EnTech and earlier multidisciplinary design positions.

services.title: Rapid parametric massing and site-option generation
services.problem: feasibility studies are slow and hard to compare when site constraints change.
services.deliverable: editable massing tool with setbacks, building footprints, levels, approximate GFA, housing mix and scenario comparison.
services.evidence: professional automated master-planning research at Stantec; City Maker and parcel tools; American Superblock prototype. Historic AMP graphics have intentionally been excluded from the recent public GitHub portfolio—do not restore them without permission.

services.title: Rule-based housing/unit generators
services.problem: rigid rectangular subdividers poorly capture useful interlocking plans, daylight, circulation and adjacency.
services.deliverable: custom room-first layout solver, unit mix/area controls, interactive SVG, adjacency graph, constraint diagnostics.
services.evidence: the November 2026 Interlock Plan Solver specification and user-supplied unit references, plus prior double-loaded-corridor logic. Treat the latest room-first algorithm as **development**, not proven production software.

services.title: Concept-to-BIM parametric building prototype
services.problem: geometry and BIM semantics drift apart.
services.deliverable: editable buildings with spaces, walls, slabs, cores, openings, element properties, level hierarchy, and experimental IFC/JSON export.
services.evidence: American Superblock; nested planner; Parametric Tower Designer; IFC export routines. Review geometry and export compatibility case-by-case.

services.title: Computational façade, envelope and tower systems
services.problem: manually modeling unique bays, façade variation, setbacks and patterned assemblies wastes time.
services.deliverable: selectable algorithms with constraint-driven generation, customizable components, live 3D review and fabrication/BIM metadata.
services.evidence: Tower Forge (ten tower algorithms), facade/window studies, fabrication automation and NOWN/MAK work.

services.title: Circulation, accessibility and egress **study tools**
services.problem: early design teams need to visualize access, door-to-door movement and bottlenecks.
services.deliverable: graph-based movement exploration and annotated route options, with outstanding code/life-safety validation explicitly flagged.
services.evidence: American Superblock door connection graphs, cores, corridors and unit egress explorations. **Not a substitute for code-consultant or licensed professional review.**

services.title: Architectural documentation directly from model geometry
services.problem: sketches, diagrams and model views disagree after parameter changes.
services.deliverable: coordinated prototype plan/section views, SVG exports, element schedules and printable design review sheets.
services.evidence: American Superblock drawing set and browser geometry controls; production construction documents are a separate, professionally reviewed service scope.

services.title: Generative public-space and activity programming
services.problem: community/landscape programs are hard to compare spatially.
services.deliverable: interactive activity kit, placement map, area/relationship data and exportable program schedule.
services.evidence: Penta Court documents twenty spatial-activity prototypes and a movable conceptual placement diagram; placements are not yet fully integrated BIM elements.

services.title: AI-assisted program/space feasibility experiments
services.problem: early briefs are incomplete and multiple requirements conflict.
services.deliverable: proof of concept that translates a brief into a program, audits omitted spaces/relationships and iterates a layout.
services.evidence: Space Maker / Space Liver / Planner prompt→program→audit experiments; experimental scope and human approval required.

services.title: Interactive browser-based BIM viewers
services.problem: stakeholders cannot easily explore complicated BIM projects without specialized desktop software.
services.deliverable: web 3D viewer with model levels, selection, property panels, slices, saved views and focused use cases.
services.evidence: American Superblock, Penta Court, tower projects; Three.js, React, That Open/IFC ecosystems.

services.title: Parametric product and building configurators
services.problem: clients need controlled alternatives, not static renderings.
services.deliverable: browser controls, rule-based geometry, material/size/option logic, cost/BOM placeholders where data supports them, and approved output formats.
services.evidence: Tower Forge and housing/model generators; manufacturing-parametric experience. Live quoting/pricing only when a validated cost model exists.

services.title: Interactive feasibility and comparison dashboards
services.problem: teams cannot see tradeoffs between scenarios in one place.
services.deliverable: adjustable inputs, visual comparisons, metrics, exports and a structured model history within the project.
services.evidence: HGA data-driven work, City Maker scenarios, American Superblock metrics, data dashboards.

services.title: Geometry/BIM-to-web pipelines
services.problem: heavy model assets and BIM metadata are hard to deliver through modern web interfaces.
services.deliverable: custom IFC/JSON/GLB workflow, element identity mapping, optimized presentation and model inspection.
services.evidence: American Superblock browser exports/GLB previews, openBIM experiments. Do not promise production native BREP jobs in static GitHub Pages without a backend.

services.title: Interactive competition and presentation experiences
services.problem: a PDF alone poorly explains generative space or time-based design.
services.deliverable: a clear interactive 3D concept site with annotated controls, visual storytelling and standalone handoff assets.
services.evidence: public-art applications, Penta Court and pavilion repositories, responsive web visualization work.

services.title: BIM/urban R&D application prototypes
services.problem: AEC innovators need rapid technical proof before building a full product.
services.deliverable: scoped proof-of-concept, architecture notes, working demo, source repository, acceptance criteria and roadmap.
services.evidence: American Superblock, Tower Forge, Space Maker, IFC Validation Webapp, BIMSpect, VIKTOR tower prototype.

services.title: Custom generative wall and ceiling systems
services.problem: complex surfaces are too slow to design and rationalize panel by panel.
services.deliverable: pattern/geometry logic, repeatable panel families, IDs, shop geometry, assembly maps and prototype coordination.
services.evidence: MAK Studio CNC-patterned and Corian walls; rhythmic timber ceiling; 2018 portfolio fabrication archive.

services.title: Thermoformed Corian / composite geometry
services.problem: sculptural solid-surface assemblies require forming and tooling logic.
services.deliverable: curvature rules, segmented part geometry, forming jig drawings, geometry coordination and fabrication specifications within agreed material tolerances.
services.evidence: MAK Studio Corian fin-wall and associated fabrication work. Confirm vendor/manufacturer limits on live commissions.

services.title: CNC-cut plywood and nested part systems
services.problem: unique parts are difficult to number, nest, machine and assemble.
services.deliverable: parameter-driven parts, identification, CNC-ready profiles, toolpath/export coordination, cut lists and assembly diagrams.
services.evidence: MAK/Aria Signs plywood systems, Grasshopper scripts, RhinoCAM/G-code-related workflows, fabrication supervision.

services.title: Folded aluminum and sheet-metal systems
services.problem: designers need complex form with rational fold lines, seams and supports.
services.deliverable: panel breakdown, fold patterns, part numbering, nesting, attachment concepts and fabrication coordination.
services.evidence: aluminum head, tessellated installation, Dragon Skin/Aria Signs, folded-aluminum professional experience.

services.title: Parametric acoustic and material systems
services.problem: acoustical/architectural products require geometries that link performance intent to feasible production.
services.deliverable: configurable patterns, size families, material/assembly logic and fabrication-ready design data; laboratory acoustic performance testing is separately scoped.
services.evidence: NOWN acoustic-panel workflows, geometric-felt/knitted system exploration, GG-loop material research.

services.title: Site-specific public art and spatial installations
services.problem: commissioners need ambitious but buildable concepts supported by fabrication evidence.
services.deliverable: concept/visual package, schematic design, component system, preliminary budget structure, material/foundation/maintenance outline, and fabrication partner coordination.
services.evidence: Lotus Flower; interactive outdoor installation; faceted sculpture; public-art RFP work. Competition proposals are concepts, not completed built works.

services.title: Data-driven and generative artworks
services.problem: institutions want site data translated into spatial, visual or physical form.
services.deliverable: algorithmic visual system, responsive digital artwork, fabricated parts concept or exhibition-ready visualizations.
services.evidence: HGA audience-driven spatial installation, TADAEX Lotus Flower, p5.js walkers/flow fields, Data Through Design flower taxonomy studies.

services.title: Furniture, pavilions and small architectural products
services.problem: a client needs a one-off spatial object or a configurable product family.
services.deliverable: parametric concept, component strategy, 3D coordination, drawings for technical review and prototyping with fabricators.
services.evidence: Pavilion repository (double-curved roof, organic columns and S-curve seating), Hoboken U-bars proposal, outdoor art concepts. Do not claim engineering approval or physical completion of these proposals.

services.title: GIS/site-data interaction tools
services.problem: parcel, land-use and context data are difficult for design teams to explore.
services.deliverable: browser mapping, editable shapes/GeoJSON, site layers, constraints and live metric overlays.
services.evidence: React/Leaflet/Turf projects with leaflet-draw, polygon operations and drawing widgets; City Maker location/site interface.

services.title: Spatial data analytics
services.problem: spatial patterns and density are hard to interpret.
services.deliverable: project-specific Voronoi, K-means, convex-hull, heatmap, spatial-join or clustering workflow with clearly defined data assumptions.
services.evidence: 2024 React/Leaflet/Turf visualization experiments; HGA data-analysis precedent.

services.title: Participatory and crowd-sourced design systems
services.problem: stakeholder preferences are hard to convert into design options.
services.deliverable: survey-to-geometry/data model, adjacency/priority logic, interactive outputs and documented interpretation limits.
services.evidence: HGA crowd-sourced architecture research and survey-driven geometry, academic design experiments.

services.title: Urban and environmental concept dashboards

services.evidence: City Maker indicators, public-data flower/time-series research, Vertical Housing viewer repository. Do not market research metrics as certified simulations.

services.title: AI workflow integration for AEC teams

services.evidence: PRISM decision-support prototype, GPT/BIM experiments, design-system development and custom automation practice.

services.title: AI-assisted geometry and planning agents

services.title: Project knowledge mapping and design-history tools

services.title: Simulations of life, use and social behavior

services.evidence: American Superblock Life Lab seeded agents, social ties and experimental reversible 3D overlays.

services.title: Design technology strategy and software audits

services.deliverable: workflow inventory, ROI hypothesis, prioritized roadmap, proof-of-concept specification and target acceptance tests.
services.evidence: more than a decade of employment and project-specific computational/BIM practice across multiple firms.

services.title: Training, workshops and technical handoff

services.deliverable: practical Rhino/Grasshopper, Revit/Dynamo, IFC and web-design-technology sessions tied to the client's actual files, with source code and recorded walkthrough where authorized.
services.evidence: tool development, documentation, technical presentations and consultancy experience. Do not imply formal accreditation. ---
